jcr:title: Adaptable positioning system
jcr:description: The Adaptable positioning system delivers precise patient-specific positioning and is designed to maximize surgical and operative access for the shoulder, inclusive of beach chair and lateral Shoulder Arthroscopy, TSA and fracture.

largeheadline.line1: Adaptable arm positioner and beach chair system
largeheadline.line2: The precise patient-specific positioning you deserve.

largeheadline_460104.line1: “Reproducible and safe positioning is the first step of any successful surgical approach and is essential for advanced surgical techniques. The Adaptable  system allows for precise positioning control within a case. In my OR, this has allowed personnel to focus more on the procedure itself.”
largeheadline_460104.line2: -Dr. Brett Sanders, M.D. and key developing surgeon

text.text: Streamlined. Reproducible. Patient positioning designed with the patient, surgeon, anesthesia and OR staff in mind.

largeheadline.line1:
Explore the
breakthrough design

text.text:
A – Unobstructed airway access​

B – Halo and Cradle design to safely position the patient's head and neck, while maintaining an open airway

​C – Head rest allows flexion to facilitate the sniffing position for intubation

​D – More planes of adjustability than any other competitor

text_copy.text: Accommodates wider range of patient sizes than the leading competitors.
Cart design allows for single-person setup and no lifting required.

text.text: Unlike other arm positioners on the market, Adaptable is fully mechanical with no need for power, batteries or compressed gas, which may improve OR efficiency. The anti-slip alumifoam is designed to prevent arm slippage.​

breakthrough design

text.text:

B – Advanced locking mechanism

​C – Ultra-lightweight carbon fiber construction

​D – Quick-mount design
